en-US.title: Echo Finders: History & Ghosts
en-US.subtitle: Walking & driving audio tours
en-US.description:
Echo Finders plays short narrated echoes of the place you are passing: its history, its people, its ghosts and legends, its true crime and the films made there. Walk a street or drive a road, and each echo plays when you reach the spot it belongs to.

An echo is one place, told in a few minutes by a narrator. History, true crime and people echoes are checked against sources before they are published. Ghost echoes and local legends are always marked as legend, so you know which is which.

WHERE IT WORKS
Wilmington and the Cape Fear coast, North Carolina: Wilmington, Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach, Kure Beach, Fort Fisher and Southport.
Savannah, Georgia.
Charleston, South Carolina.
New Orleans, Louisiana.
Washington, DC.
Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
New York City.
Boston, Massachusetts.
Houston, Texas.
New cities and towns are added as their echoes are finished.

HOW IT WORKS
Start where you are. Echo Finders uses your location to find the echoes nearby and plays each one as you arrive.
Take a guided walk, such as the Wilmington 1898 walk or the Lower Manhattan walk, or simply wander.
Walk with your phone in your pocket: echoes start on their own as you reach them, with the screen off.
Drive a route, such as Wilmington to Fort Fisher and the Southport ferry, and hear the road as you go.
Hold up your phone and the camera shows which echoes are around you.
Download a city before you go and listen with no signal.
Save the echoes you like and come back to them later.

WHAT YOU HEAR
History: what happened on the spot.
Ghosts and legends: haunted houses and local lore, marked as legend.
True crime: real cases, told from court records and reporting.
Film locations: where films and shows were shot.
Notable people: who lived, worked or was born here.
Unsolved mysteries, disasters, music, firsts and hidden places.

WHAT IT COSTS
Your first echoes are free.
Week Pass: one city for 7 days.
City Pass: one city for good, including echoes added there later.
All-Access: every city and every drive for a year. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the year, which you can do in your Apple Account settings.

No account to create. Your exact location stays on your phone.
